_comment: The v5r pack's own settings defaults. Pure data on purpose: the plugin must fold these UNDER the user's settings BEFORE the kernel is constructed, and a synchronous JSON read is the only way to do that from a plugin whose top level cannot await. Every key must exist in settings/schema.js; the gate can check that, because a default for an undeclared key is a typo that would otherwise fail silently.
_round2: ROUND 2 (D-08): the v5r INSTITUTION's preferences for the new primitives (chat / mailbox / panel / resume / human / math jobs). These are STRATEGY, not mechanism: the kernel primitives read them and enforce; the pack only says what this institution wants. Values are grounded in _handoff/vmu/v5r-inventory-c.md (chat/panel/meeting) and inventory-a (resume). The reporting policy is NOT here: it is declared on the loaded manifest (packs/v5r/prompts/v5r-core.js) and applied by the pack loader - a key declared in both places would be refused as a conflict (O4).
_round7: ROUND 7 fidelity audit (Lead ruling): `vmu.math.maxParallel` below is a RESTATEMENT OF THE FRAMEWORK DEFAULT (def 1) and is NOT fidelity evidence - v5r's own parameter for this is `leanJobsMaxParallel: 1` (vibe-math-v5r.js:1119), whose framework twin `vmu.math.leanJobsMaxParallel` already defaults to 1. It is kept because an integration pack should be readable and tunable. The real round-7 fidelity corrections are documented in defaults.js: `vmu.turn.selfCheck` true->false (v5r:1122 resourceSelfCheck false), `vmu.control.idleAfterMs: 120000` (v5r:1082 activityTimeoutMs), and the REMOVAL of `vmu.limits.maxLiveMembers: 3` (v5r:1130 maxLiveChildren 0 = no cap).
_round9: PHASE 9 ROUND 7 — ONE LINE WAS DELETED HERE ON PURPOSE: the pack used to spell out a seven-kind list for the mailbox's automatic-urgency key, which SHADOWED the schema's new default (an empty list: nothing is urgent by kind out of the box; urgency comes only from the sender explicitly saying urgent:true). While that stale explicit value sat here, `kind:'notice'` stayed automatically urgent and the sender could not win. A stale explicit value is WORSE than 'not set': it looks configured while its semantics are old. RULE: this institution has no reason to restate a framework default; if a day comes when it really wants kind-driven urgency, it must declare the list explicitly AND write the institution's reason here — never copy an outdated default. Pinned by tests/vmu-v5r-tools.test.mjs §7k (the pack's value layer must not carry that key).

defaults._requireSettledRecords: PHASE 7 ROUND 3 (Lead ruling): FALSE, so a draft proposition can be written and promoted later by the verified track (the original workflow). This key is SNAPSHOTTED at kernel construction (kernel/records.js:189-221), so the VALUE layer is the only effective owner; the manifest line was removed to keep exactly one owner (a duplicate is refused as VMU_PACK_CONFLICT).
defaults._v5rFixtureMode: PHASE 7 ROUND 10: the SLV fixture switch. 'no-tools' (default) keeps the historical instruction ('本轮不调用工具') so previous rounds' results stay comparable; 'tools' enables the v5r-fixture-tools variant ('本轮可以且应该调用工具'). READ AT CALL TIME by the pack's prompt policy (decideSections), so the value layer is sufficient — no kernel construction snapshot is involved.
defaults._objective: PHASE 7 ROUND 19 — 'WHAT IS THIS INSTITUTE RESEARCHING' IS PACK POLICY (red line 1), NOT FRAMEWORK POLICY. The declaration's default is the placeholder '（尚未设定）', and the charter interpolates the value verbatim; a real run showed members reading that placeholder and (correctly) refusing to invent a problem from the turn's `why`. This institution therefore carries its own objective in the VALUE layer: a small, definitely-true claim with an explicit acceptance standard — and the members have already demonstrated that they judge it honestly (they voted false while the evidence was incomplete). MEASURED READ PATH: the template interpolation `{{ setting:vmu.turn.objective }}` is resolved at ASSEMBLY time from the call's settings (probe: passing a marker in ctx.settings replaced the value), and the turn loop passes its settings view at kernel/turn/index.js:741 — so the value layer is both sufficient and the right owner.
defaults.vmu.turn.objective: 本所本期目标：确立并证明『前 n 个奇数之和的封闭形式 n²』——即对任意正整数 n，1 + 3 + 5 + … + (2n−1) = n²；验收标准是给出完整的四步数学归纳证明（基础情形 n=1、归纳假设、归纳步 n²+(2(n+1)−1)=(n+1)²、结论），并把证明归档进本所成果库。
defaults._latexEngineOrder: PHASE 7 round 9 — THE TEXTBOOK CASE OF 'POLICY IN THE PACK': the kernel's default order is NEUTRAL (pdflatex then xelatex, settings/schema.js:1057) and it deliberately does not know that Chinese documents need xelatex for CJK. THIS institution declares its preference here, in the value layer: xelatex first, exactly the original v5r's zh order (vibe-math-v5r.js:231-234). Uninstall the pack and the neutral default comes back.
defaults._chairRails: 规则「会议只能由院士（chair）预约/召开和关闭」「院士可以延长会议时长上界」是【本所的制度】，不是框架的：内核把三条都做成默认 false（零机制），这里才是它们被采纳的地方。★ 不在这里重述 vmu.meetings.extendRequiresChair / extendCeilingMs —— 内核默认已是 true / 14400000ms，重述等于把框架默认抄进价值层（本文件 §rule: 一个过时的显式值比「没设」更糟）。
